_comment: The five MVP weapons: the gun and the flamethrower, copied from the Unity prototype (docs/weapons/unity-weapons-report.md, sections 2 to 5) with the board's fixes (docs/weapons.md, Decisions): damage is never rounded, the flame area is the same size in every direction, missed bullets are removed once past the gun's range. Distances in units (1 unit = the car's width), times in seconds. A tier is 'effect' plus 'value'; effects add up in tier order. Tier 1 is getting the weapon; tiers 2 to max_tier are its upgrades (max_tier: 8 for every weapon without its own; the gun's own is 8 too, and Bricks and the wiper stop at tier 7 until T-498 and T-499 add their tier 8). The gun and the flamethrower never push enemies; of the five only the wiper pushes (knockback_distance, minions only, never the kaiju). The underglow entry is the Game Data Agent's proposal (T-166) for the board's playtest; the gun, flamethrower, molotov, bricks and wiper tiers are the board's own upgrade trees (docs/weapons.md, Decisions, 'The board's own upgrade trees', 2026-11-02; T-496); wiper sweep_arc_degrees is the semicircle, sweep_degrees_per_second how fast the arm turns, hit_cooldown the seconds before the same enemy can be hit again.

gun._comment: The gun (Weapons, Decisions, 'The gun one-shots minions and grows in bullets, speed and targets', 2026-10-30; T-408). damage 4 = a minion's health (enemies.json minion.health), so one bullet kills one. max_tier is the gun's own last tier (8, the same as the top-level max_tier; T-496). targets_per_volley is how many enemies a volley aims at: 1 all run (the whole volley at one target, bullets delay_between_bullets apart; a bullet whose target died before it left aims at the closest living enemy instead). The board dropped Multi-Target Mode (2026-11-02, T-496), so no tier uses set_targets, though the code still understands it. fire_rate_multiplier 1.2 is the '20% faster' of the level-up cards (T-412); tier 8 is x4 (Exposure for Everyone). The old range and pierce tiers are gone; range stays 12.
gun.targets_checked: once per fire interval, closest enemy first

bricks._comment: Bricks (Weapons, Decisions, 2026-10-28; base numbers proposed in T-323, tiers 2 to 7 the board's own tree of 2026-11-02, T-496; tier 8, Widest Wave, comes with T-498; reasons in docs/weapons.md, Content, 'Bricks'). Each time the car lands after being in the air for at least min_air_seconds, one impact wave goes out around it: every enemy within radius takes damage once and minions are pushed knockback_distance away (never the kaiju). The same wave whatever the height of the fall (first build). Offered at level-ups since T-324 built the weapon (scripts/weapons/bricks.gd): offered_in_level_ups is true and 'bricks' is in WEAPON_ORDER and ALL_IDS in level_up_offers.gd.
